The SIDE VIEW shows a vertically oriented, C-shaped component with a curved body and a rectangular base plate. The base plate depth is approximately 20% of the total height (129.66 mm), estimated at 26 mm. The curved body extends upward from the base plate, with a rounded inner edge and a flat outer edge. The component features three horizontal ribs: one near the base plate, one mid-height, and one near the top, each roughly 10 mm wide and spaced 30 mm apart. There is a single circular hole near the top, with a diameter of approximately 25 mm, aligned with the center of the curved body. No other holes or features are visible.

The isometric view shows a 3D mechanical part with a main U-shaped bracket that opens upward (toward the viewer). The base plate is the flat, rectangular bottom section with two mounting holes on its left side. The U-shaped bracket has a central circular hole, two smaller holes on the top flange (for mounting), and a cutout on the right side for a U-shaped attachment or fitting.
